title: Mailbox/set destroy fetches ALL emails when only mailbox-member emails are needed
description: mailbox.rs handle_mailbox_set destroy loop:523-527 calls get_objects::<Email>(account_id, None, None) to get ALL emails in the account, then filters by mailbox_id. For accounts with many emails, this is O(total_emails) when O(emails_in_mailbox) would suffice. Impact grows with account size. Fix: add a MailBackend::get_emails_in_mailbox(&Id) -> Vec<Email> method, or pass the mailbox_ids filter through query_objects.
